tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Introduction to the xuan-daliuren module, its purpose as a divination engine, and its clean architecture layout. This module provides a standalone implementation of the Da Liu Ren divination system.

tour.title: Core Domain Logic (Calculators)
tour.description: The heart of the engine. These services implement the complex mathematical and metaphysical rules of Da Liu Ren, including the Three Transmissions (San Chuan), Four Classes (Si Ke), and Heaven-Earth Pan calculations.

tour.title: Data Persistence (Drift/DAOs)
tour.description: Local-first data management using the Drift (formerly Moor) persistence library. Handles storage of preset divination maps, user results, and initialization data.

tour.title: UI & Interaction
tour.description: The presentation layer following the MVVM pattern. Includes specialized widgets for visualizing divination results and managing user interaction through the DaLiuRenViewModel.
